name: adversarial-review-s3-completeness-critic
title: Adversarial-review S3: completeness-critic role (what-did-review-miss seam) + MVP real-lane provenance tagging
description: Story S3 (MVP) of the adversarial-review build program (docs/adversarial-review-spec.md §2.4 + §4.3). Implement the COMPLETENESS-CRITIC ROLE as a pure-data + injected-seam module packages/main/src/core/adversarial-review-critic.ts importing S0 (core/adversarial-review.ts: CompletenessCriticInput{change,confirmedFindings}, Finding) and S2 (core/adversarial-review-verifier.ts: toFindingAddArgs, FindingAddArgs) plus REVIEW_RUN_LANES/ReviewRunLane from core/review-run.ts read-only. (1) runCompletenessCritic(input: CompletenessCriticInput, runCritic: (input)=>Finding[]): Finding[] applies the injected critic seam to {change, confirmedFindings} (the VERIFIED lens findings per §2.4 — the critic never sees raw noise) and returns the critic raw findings UNCHANGED and UNPRIVILEGED (they re-enter S2 verification — that re-verification + reopen loop is S4, not here). (2) MVP PROVENANCE (§4.3): COMPLETENESS_CRITIC_DESC_TAG='[completeness-critic]'; CRITIC_PROVENANCE_RECOMMENDED_LANES=['lattice-review-quality','lattice-review-behavior']; toCriticFindingAddArgs(finding,{reviewRunId,agent,category}) wraps S2 toFindingAddArgs and PREFIXES the desc with the tag, typing agent as a REAL ReviewRunLane so the compiler rejects 'completeness-critic' in --agent (provenance lives in --desc, the real lane in --agent — putting completeness-critic in --agent would not count as reviewer-lane evidence). Pure: no I/O, no finding_add call. A hermetic smoke with a FAKE runCritic proves: runCompletenessCritic passes {change,confirmedFindings} to the seam and returns its findings unchanged; toCriticFindingAddArgs prefixes [completeness-critic] in the desc, keeps the S2-mapped severity (no abstract leak), keeps a real lane in agent, and is otherwise toFindingAddArgs. NO lens runner (S1), NO verifier/threshold (S2), NO escalation/reopen/finding_add call (S4). Registered in lattice.config.json. Depends [B-53c5, B-2806].
